chose: 2.4 PRIVACY RULING (operator, 2026-09-22), approving the recommendation put to them. The native-memory bridge is:
- IMPORT-ONLY: native memory into sofar, never sofar into native memory.
- OFF BY DEFAULT: nothing is imported unless the operator runs the import.
- Limited to project and reference entries, never user or feedback ones.
- Operator-approved: each candidate is shown to the operator, so every imported entry is one they chose to share.
Nothing reaches the record before approval. An imported entry is marked as coming from native memory, not the operator's own words.
over: Automatic import; importing every type; exporting sofar into native memory; a local-only store for imports; dropping 2.4 altogether
because: The two stores have opposite exposure. Native memory is private to the operator's machine. A sofar record is committed and cloned, and it syncs when cloud sync is on; this repo is public.
